content.user_title: Create Agent Skills for Claude Code
content.value_statement: Writing reusable AI skills requires clear scope, frontmatter, and validation. This skill guides Claude Code through skill structure, examples, testing, and troubleshooting.
actual_capabilities: Guides scope definition for a focused Agent Skill.
Explains personal and project skill directory choices.
Defines required SKILL.md frontmatter fields and naming rules.
Provides Markdown structure patterns for skill instructions and examples.
Lists validation, testing, activation, and troubleshooting checks.
Shows common single-file and multi-file skill patterns.
limitations: Does not provide an automated validator or test runner.
Examples are generic and need adaptation for each workflow.
File creation still requires user approval or normal agent tool use.
Claude Code behavior can vary by local configuration and installed version.

use_cases.title: Create a Personal Skill
use_cases.description: Build a focused skill for a repeated personal workflow with clear activation language and validation steps.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Skill Authoring
use_cases.description: Define shared conventions for project skills, frontmatter, examples, and troubleshooting guidance.

use_cases.title: Convert a Workflow Into a Skill
use_cases.description: Turn an existing prompt, checklist, or process into a reusable Claude Code skill structure.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new single-purpose skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a Claude Code skill for [workflow]. Ask me for the scope, target users, required files, and activation phrases.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Skill Frontmatter
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of an existing SKILL.md description.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my SKILL.md frontmatter. Make the name valid, improve the description, and ensure it includes what the skill does and when to use it.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Multi-File Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for references, examples, scripts, and templates.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a multi-file skill for [domain]. Recommend the file structure, what belongs in SKILL.md, and which supporting files should use progressive disclosure.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Skill Activation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced troubleshooting for a skill that does not load or trigger.
prompt_templates.prompt: My Claude Code skill does not activate for relevant requests. Check likely causes in the description, file location, frontmatter, and testing workflow.

output_examples.input: I want a skill for reviewing Terraform plans.
output_examples.output: A focused skill plan with a valid name, activation description, expected files, example workflow, and testing checklist.

output_examples.input: My skill does not activate when I ask for spreadsheet analysis.
output_examples.output: A troubleshooting checklist covering description specificity, file location, frontmatter validity, and restart or debug steps.

output_examples.input: Convert our release checklist into a reusable skill.
output_examples.output: A proposed skill scope, SKILL.md outline, supporting reference files, concrete examples, and validation criteria.

best_practices: Keep each skill focused on one clear capability.
Write descriptions with concrete trigger phrases and file types.
Validate frontmatter, directory names, examples, and activation behavior before sharing.
anti_patterns: Do not create broad skills that cover unrelated workflows.
Do not omit dependencies, required files, or setup assumptions.
Do not rely on vague descriptions that fail skill discovery.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create Claude Code Agent Skills with clear scope, valid frontmatter, structured instructions, and testing guidance.

faq.question: Can it update an existing SKILL.md file?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review frontmatter, improve descriptions, restructure instructions, and add validation guidance.

faq.question: Does it create files automatically?
faq.answer: It can guide file creation when normal agent tools are available and the user approves the requested changes.

faq.question: Does it support project and personal skills?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains both project skills and personal skills, including when each location is appropriate.

faq.question: Can it help with skill activation problems?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes checks for descriptions, file locations, YAML frontmatter, restart behavior, and debug mode.

faq.question: Is it limited to Claude Code?
faq.answer: The guidance is written for Claude Code Agent Skills. Some authoring principles also help Codex and Claude workflows.
